marta: Nightly eval (EVAL-2026-03-19-22) flagged a weird parroting / context-shift on the q4a quant bring-up run. Obs: model repeats a short snippet from the prompt after ~80 tokens and then loops.

raj: ugh. can you paste the snippet? is this from the legal-summaries promptset?

marta: yes legal-summaries. here's the failing chunk from the gen (truncated):
```
User: Summarize the following contract clause for a non-legal audience.
Model: The clause states that the party must provide notice within 30 days. The clause states that the party must provide notice within 30 days. The clause states that the party must provide notice within 30 days. The clause states that the party must provide notice within 30 days....
```

elena: that's classic parroting but it's happening mid-answer, not just echoing the prompt. seen any tokenization regressions after the quant sweep?

bryan: CI run shows q4a-int8 profile used. nightlies note: "prefix_cache_hit" spiked for this workload around 03:12. nightly-evals-bot: also attached eval trace id trace-58c.

raj: interesting — prefix_cache_hit spike could mean the KV cache matched a short prefix and then the model kept reusing that cached logits leading to loop. can we repro locally with the same seed & prompt?

marta: repro script: 
```bash
python tests/repro_parrot.py --model redwood-q4a-int8 --prompt-file tests/data/legal-summaries/sample-12.txt --seed 42 --max-tokens 400 --stream=false
```
I can reproduce a deterministic loop on my devbox.

elena: try disabling prefix caching + run with smaller batch size. if loop goes away that points to caching interaction.

bryan: ran with --disable-prefix-cache and single token batch -> no loop, completes with sensible summary.

marta: ok that narrows it. likely KV cache/quant kernel interplay. filing a bisect: assign to @raj for kernel vs runtime check, @elena to look at tokenization/merge differences between float and q4a build.

raj: will bisect kernel selection & see if a particular fused-attn kernel introduces repeated logits pattern. sharing a todo: bisect-run-201987 (will post results here).

elena: I'll diff tokenizer outputs between fp16 and q4a artifacts for that sample. quick check: run `python tools/token_diff.py --a builds/fp16/sample-12.toks --b builds/q4a/sample-12.toks`

marta: also adding regen-eval for the same prompt set with increased sampling temperature (0.9) to see whether deterministic decoding was amplifying the loop.

bryan: note for replay: attach full eval trace + kernel selection log: /artifacts/evals/trace-58c/ — it has perf counters and kernel names.

raj: initial bisect shows kernel v3.2.1->v3.2.3 change correlates with loop reproducer. stepping through kernels now.

marta: thanks. tagging this as P1 for the nightly regression board. will update eval ticket EVAL-2026-03-19-22 with findings. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Deploy check completed for repro jobs. 2/2 runs passed without loop when prefix cache disabled.

marta: next steps: (1) raj to identify kernel fix or fallback policy, (2) elena to confirm tokenizer parity, (3) brryan to add a guard in runtime to avoid infinite repetition (max-repeat heuristic) until root cause fixed.

raj: assigned, will post bisect delta and test patch by EOD tomorrow.

elena: on it, will post tokenizer diff by EOD.

bryan: I'll draft a short mitigation PR that clamps repeated-phrase probability after 3 repeats. low-risk hotfix.

marta: perfect. thanks all, keeping this thread as canonical for the triage.
